Functions
cpct_restoreCRTC

Restore CRTC with default CPC settings.  Set video to 80 bytes x 200 lines and video memory at 0xC000 - 0xFFFF

C Definition

void cpct_restoreCRTC (void);

Assembly call:

call cpct_restoreCRTC_asm

Destroyed Register values: AF, BC, DE, HL

Required memory: 43 bytes

Details

See cpct_setStackLocation, cpct_setCRTCReg, cpct_setVideoMemoryPage for informations.
